about.title: Who is Hossam Mabrouk?
about.lead: Hossam Mabrouk is an international trade, sourcing, and manufacturing specialist focused on China. He shares practical experience across importing, exporting, product sourcing, supplier negotiations, product development, shipping, and supply chain operations.
about.paragraph2: His journey began through direct hands-on execution across China's major industrial hubs, factories, and trade centers — navigating every phase from product research and supplier selection to quality control, manufacturing, and global shipping.
about.paragraph3: Through this practical experience, his primary focus is guiding entrepreneurs, business owners, and traders to navigate the Chinese market effectively, minimize commercial risks, and make data-driven decisions when selecting suppliers and manufacturing partners.
about.paragraph4: Hossam is dedicated to simplifying global trade knowledge through educational content, combining field-tested sourcing experience with modern business technology and AI solutions.
about.quote: Our mission is empowering the next generation of entrepreneurs to build professional global trade ventures with confidence.
about.author: — Hossam Mabrouk
